collection_method: Manual public web research. Each figure was read on the cited page (not inferred from search snippets). Pages that could not be read are listed in unavailable_sources and contribute no values.

records.title: Average NFL ticket price — 2024 Fan Cost Index
records.publisher: Team Marketing Report Fan Cost Index, as reported by Fortune (Joshua Hong)
records.publication_year_note: Fortune article published September 15, 2026; it cites TMR's 2024 report.
records.methodology: Team Marketing Report's Fan Cost Index average ticket price; Fortune reports the 2024 report found the average NFL ticket rose 12.2% to $136.38.
records.limitations: League-wide average, not the Colts or any selected venue. A price average, not revenue actually collected, discounts, comps or resale prices. The original TMR release page returned HTTP 404 when checked, so this is cited through Fortune's report. 2024 nominal dollars.
records.usage_status: Single factual figure with attribution; article text not redistributed.

records.title: Raiders average no-show rate, first season with fans at Allegiant Stadium
records.publisher: Sports Business Journal (Ben Fischer), as reported by ProFootballTalk
records.methodology: Reporter reconstruction: attendance in published box scores compared with figures in quarterly operating reports to the stadium authority. Excludes the Week 18 game played in 2022. The season is the team's first with fans at Allegiant Stadium (2021).
records.limitations: One team, one season. The report says a strict vaccine mandate and large ticket blocks given to casino and hotel patrons likely raised it. The NFL does not publish no-show rates, so this is a reference point, not a league average or a forecast.
records.usage_status: Single factual figure with attribution; article text not redistributed.

records.title: Average workers at each NFL game — NFLPA estimate
records.publisher: NFL Players Association estimate, reported by the Associated Press (via Fox News)
records.venue_type: All game-day jobs at NFL games
records.methodology: Union estimate quoted in lockout coverage: 'an average of 3,739 workers at each game', excluding jobs at places near the stadium. Method not described.
records.limitations: 2011 estimate from a party to a labor dispute; method, year and role mix are not published. Covers all game-day jobs (concessions, parking, security, ushers, cleaning and more), unlike Castella's illustrative crowd-staff ratio. Not a staffing requirement.
records.usage_status: Single factual figure with attribution; article text not redistributed.

records.title: Superdome game-day employees (ticket-takers, janitors and others)
records.methodology: Reporter's statement: 'the 2,500 ticket-takers, janitors and other game-day employees at the Superdome'.
records.limitations: Not attributed to the venue or team; 2011; roles beyond ticket-takers and janitors not specified. One venue only.
records.usage_status: Single factual figure with attribution; article text not redistributed.

records.title: Game-day workforce per 1,000 attendees (derived reference)
records.publisher: Castella derivation from the NFLPA estimate and the bundled 2010 attendance export
records.publication_year_note: Derived in Castella; not a published ratio.
records.venue_type: All game-day jobs, scaled per reported attendee
records.methodology: 3,739 workers per game (NFLPA, 2011) ÷ 66,956.48 mean reported attendance per game in the 2010 season (bundled TidyTuesday export, 512 nonmissing team-week observations) × 1,000, rounded to 2 decimals.
records.limitations: Combines an undocumented union estimate with reported (not scanned) attendance from the season before it. Assumes workforce scales linearly with crowd size, which real venues do not do exactly (fixed crews exist). Use as an order-of-magnitude reference, never as a staffing requirement.

unavailable_sources.reason: HTTP 404 when checked; TMR figures are cited through Fortune instead.
Redirected to an unrelated homepage; no SoFi Stadium headcount was read, so none is used.

not_available.concession_spending_per_attendee: No verified league or venue per-attendee concession spending figure was read on a primary or attributed page. Survey-based figures found in search results conflict and were not used. Spending remains a user assumption.
not_available.beer_hot_dog_parking_prices: Per-item 2024 Fan Cost Index prices were not readable (TMR page 404); not used.
not_available.league_no_show_rate: The NFL does not publish no-show rates; only the single-team Raiders reference is included.
